metadata.title: AlphaFold3 on TPU and GPU: inputs, targets, manifests, data freeze and run records
metadata.description:
Record R1 of the study: the frozen AlphaFold3 inputs with their ColabFold MSAs, targets, manifests, every data freeze (final identifier d706dffc07fec6d86471e28f062178e4f309193d3bfd6a66de47959eb3bfdd8f, 607 sessions), session lists, the run records of the main study, follow-ups 1 to 21 and the two later measurements (memlimit_ah, warm_th), the records of sessions outside the freeze mapped to the analysis plan, and a copy of the code at the repository commit tagged zenodo-v1.

No AlphaFold3 Output and no model parameters are in this record. The outputs, the results of AlphaFold3's data pipeline, the follow-up 6 deliveries and the XLA dumps of follow-up 16 are in the companion record, 10.5281/zenodo.24057544, under the AlphaFold 3 Output Terms of Use. Provenance files are released with the contact address and home paths redacted; REDACTIONS.tsv lists each file with the SHA-256 of the original and of the released copy. LICENCES.md gives the licence of every third-party source and of each archive.

Pre-registration on OSF: project https://osf.io/qtz3v, main study https://osf.io/fegsy, addenda of follow-ups 10 (https://osf.io/nsbgp), 11 (https://osf.io/64bpy), 13 (https://osf.io/c4kh7), 14 (https://osf.io/eafkx), 15 (https://osf.io/h9yw8), 16 (https://osf.io/hcxm7), 17 (https://osf.io/x4hry), 18 (https://osf.io/mq8fh), 19 (https://osf.io/4cbgf), 20 (https://osf.io/hjf8z) and 21 (https://osf.io/ctv2d).

Paper: see the related identifiers of this Zenodo record (arXiv preprint and conference version, added when available).
